The '''husliki''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] that had a bumpy hide. In [[21 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Devi (miner)|Devi]], a [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who lived in the village [[Torbel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]], wore her [[Hair/Legends|hair]] fastened in tiny knots in a style that caused the knots to stand up on top of her head and resemble a husliki's hide.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
